inventory_append.title: Planning and publishing should stay separate
inventory_append.hook: Planning and publishing do not need to share one authority.
inventory_append.body: OneClickPostFactory plans, queues and records tenant-owned posts; a separate Social Agent worker handles publishing.
inventory_append.cta: Which publishing responsibility would you separate first?

inventory_append.title: One repository should own the product truth
inventory_append.hook: Two repositories should not both look canonical.
inventory_append.body: OneClickPostFactory names one app repo as canonical and treats older social-pulse repos as history, not parallel authority.
inventory_append.cta: Where does repository ownership become ambiguous?

inventory_append.title: Validation is not deployment proof
inventory_append.hook: A green CI run is not deployment evidence.
inventory_append.body: OneClickPostFactory separates source validation from production Cloudflare deployment, so live deployment still needs separate proof.
inventory_append.cta: What production assumption do you infer from CI?

inventory_append.title: Production deployment should be explicit
inventory_append.hook: Production deploys should be deliberate, not automatic.
inventory_append.body: Pull requests and pushes validate source; production Cloudflare deployment stays behind a separate approved workflow.
inventory_append.cta: Which deploy step deserves explicit approval?

inventory_append.title: Live traffic needs separate evidence
inventory_append.hook: CI cannot tell you which build is serving real traffic.
inventory_append.body: OneClickPostFactory treats source validation, deploy workflow state and active Cloudflare traffic as separate evidence.
inventory_append.cta: What do you check after CI before calling a release live?
